mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications ( id, receiver_id, actor_id, order_id, chat_room_id, chat_message_id, post_id, comment_id, review_id, review_reply_id, user_coupon_id, notification_type, title, content, delivery_scope, is_read, read_at, event_key, created_at ) VALUES (#{id}, #{receiverId}, #{actorId}, #{orderId}, #{chatRoomId}, #{chatMessageId}, #{postId}, #{commentId}, #{reviewId}, #{reviewReplyId}, #{userCouponId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{deliveryScope}, #{isRead}, #{readAt}, #{eventKey}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, notification_type AS type, title, content, is_read AS isRead, created_at AS createdAt, order_id AS orderId, chat_room_id AS chatRoomId, post_id AS postId, review_id AS reviewId, user_coupon_id AS userCouponId FROM notifications WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} ORDER BY created_at desc LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = true, read_at = NOW() WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = false
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM notifications WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = false
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT true FROM notifications WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND event_key = #{eventKey} LIMIT 1 )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_deliveries ( id, notification_id, channel, recipient, template_code, provider_message_id, status, failure_code, failure_reason, requested_at, sent_at, delivered_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES (#{id}, #{notificationId}, #{channel}, #{recipient}, #{templateCode}, #{providerMessageId}, #{status}, #{failureCode}, #{failureReason}, #{requestedAt}, #{sentAt}, #{deliveredAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
